record_type: Internal analysis specification, recorded before scoring or examining individual target values. No public time registration is claimed.
primary_source: yeonduhaeyo/diecasting-project, data/train.csv, Git commit 3010621441321d2d51f8043d0edc4ac6440cd80f, Git blob 5319bc94337c0ad0284553f2611f5ec31c13fd98, 17920698 bytes
selection_basis: A distinct metal die-casting process with timestamped shot-level process measurements and a quality outcome. Public search snippets exposed an aggregate failure prevalence. The choice was made without reviewing any outcome rows, per-date counts, or scores from this analysis.
design: External evaluation of the fixed learning procedure on a new process, with a model fitted to its earlier records. A separate sensor schema prevents use of the original ProBayes fitted weights. This is a retrospective test.
outcome: Released passorfail designation (1 = defect, 0 = pass), verified against data documentation. Do not redefine defects, resample by outcome, or select test dates using outcomes.
eligibility: Use released records with a valid registration_time and a documented binary target. Do not exclude trials, outliers, mold changes or other records by inspection outcome. Retain source file order for rows tied on timestamp. Report removed rows, provenance and whether the data cover complete throughput. Never imply this labeled competition file documents all factory output.
time_split: Sort unique eligible recorded dates chronologically; the first floor(0.70 x number of dates) are training dates, all remaining dates form a single untouched test period. Require at least 2 training and 2 testing days. Fit at most 2048 training records, selected by the smallest SHA-256 of the ASCII decimal zero-based source row ordinal, independent of labels. Use every eligible test row. Do not adjust rules to obtain positive events.
inputs: Allow only shot process measurements identifiable from source schema: molten_temp, sleeve_temperature, low_section_speed, high_section_speed, cast_pressure, biscuit_thickness, physical_strength, upper_mold_temp1/2/3, lower_mold_temp1/2/3 (also equivalently named lower/upper_mold_temperature fields), Coolant_temperature, EMS_operation_time, facility_operation_cycleTime, production_cycletime. Match case-insensitively. Omit missing fields and require at least 4 variable numeric sensors. Exclude dates, IDs, counts, mold or product codes, shift, operator, try-shot status, setting or furnace IDs, target and inspection-derived data. Treat nonnumeric and missing sensor values as missing, fit median imputation, nonconstant filter, standardization and four-component unwhitened PCA on training only. Do not change sensors after scoring.
rankings: Original coupled and uncoupled two-layer four-qubit feature maps and matched four-PC RBF with fixed original C=1, balanced class weights, relative gamma=1, quantum scale=0.5, from the retained implementation. Class-balanced four-PC logistic regression with C=1 and chronological selection are secondary controls. Prohibit tuning, seed search, selection using test outcomes or changing the test window. The fixed training cap applies to all fitted methods.
primary_endpoint: Counts of defective eligible test shots selected by the coupled model minus matched RBF at a common 10% test-period budget ceil(0.10*Ntest), allocated to each day by the original largest-remainder rule, earlier date first for remainder ties. Within day score descending, chronological source-row order for score ties. Report both counts, total positives, recall if defined, quota per date, and number of dates with a defect retrieved. Count a date only if at least one defective shot is selected. Report distinct eligible mold identifiers and their distribution if available; no lot-level claims without a real lot key.
secondary: Report coupled-minus-uncoupled and logistic/chronology counts at 10%, pooled AP, the running cumulative-volume quota at the same allowance, and uniform expected detections over exact cutoff ties; report per-date results. Label any subsequently added analyses exploratory.
independence_and_limits: Do not pool this process with the original cohorts. Retain opposite results, null findings and zero-event dates. If there are no eligible test failures, recall is unidentified. If the source cannot be acquired with verified identity or critical column semantics cannot be established, record the obstacle and do not replace it based on observed performance. Computing or helper changes that preserve the specified rows, inputs, models and endpoints may be documented.
verification: Verify pinned blob from complete bytes before parsing, preserve source SHA-256, original row order, actual included features, cohort dates/counts and score digests. Freeze the ranked predictions before joining held-out outcomes for endpoint evaluation. This is an internally time-ordered specification, not a public preregistration.
